parameters.name: BillOwnerId
parameters.description: The ID of the account that owns the resource. The resource owner is the account that uses the resource.

parameters.name: EndPeriod
parameters.description: The end of the time range to query. The end time is exclusive. If you do not set this parameter, the current time is used as the end time. The time format is yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss.

parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description: The maximum number of results to return.

parameters.name: PeriodType
parameters.description: The time granularity for the usage summary. Valid values: MONTH, DAY, and HOUR.

parameters.name: StartPeriod
parameters.description: The beginning of the time range to query. The start time is inclusive. The time format is yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss.

parameters.name: Token
parameters.description: The token for paging. Leave this empty for the first query. The response includes a token for the next page. An empty token means all data has been returned.
